scenario_name: Checkout Service Thread Pool Starvation via Upstream Dependency Latency
trigger_event: Third-party payment partner API (api.partner-payments.io) experienced latency degradation (>28s).
root_cause_summary: Third-party payment gateway degraded to 28s response times. Because checkout-service lacked client-side socket timeouts and circuit breakers, all 100 worker threads blocked waiting for HTTP responses, causing complete thread pool starvation and unresponsive health checks.

expected_evidence_signals.description: Upstream partner latency metric spiking to >28,000ms.
Active worker thread count hitting 100% capacity while CPU is near 0%.
Outbound log identifying partner payment gateway as the bottleneck.

key_actions: Configure 2500ms socket timeout and circuit breaker for partner-payments client
Enable asynchronous fallback payment queue (degraded checkout mode)
Restart checkout-service pods to reclaim blocked worker threads
expected_remediation.expected_verification_metric: Verify server/active_worker_threads drops below 30 and P99 latency returns under 200ms.

expected_diagnostic_conclusion: Diagnose checkout-service failure as Downstream Dependency Latency causing Thread Pool Starvation due to missing client timeouts.

metadata.title: Checkout Service Complete Freeze: Thread Pool Deadlock
metadata.impact_summary: 100% of customer checkouts hanging and timing out due to upstream payment partner latency.
